given: a warehouse operator using the updated UI wherever the combined inventory_code was previously shown
when: they view stock in the list, detail, or form
then: no combined inventory_code string is displayed anywhere; only the separate batch_number and serial_number fields appear in its place

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 assert the separate batch/serial fields are present and correctly rendered; this AC asserts the old combined code is gone from the UI. A build could add the new fields while still showing the legacy inventory_code alongside them, passing the prior ACs but failing this one, so its removal is independently observable and breakable.

architectural_notes: E2E: a negative assertion across every SPA surface (list, detail, form) that the legacy combined inventory_code no longer renders, consistent with S1 dropping the inventory_code column from stock_records (PI3 reversibility). The JSON boundary no longer serializes inventory_code and the SPA presentation layer no longer references it (NFR-F6-5); removal is a client presentation concern verified against real branch data with the column gone. Owner module is the SPA stock components; no domain/business logic is involved in the removal.
